MULTIPLE 0.3, A JUDGEMENT: 0.3 x 0.511 = 0.1533. For: SKYGLO adds glofitamab on top of Pola-R-CHP rather than replacing it, so a positive PFS result sells into the regimen Roche already holds in first line, through Roche's own lymphoma sales force. Against: a T-cell engager with step-up dosing and cytokine release syndrome monitoring in first-line community practice; AbbVie and Genmab's epcoritamab plus R-CHOP and Regeneron's odronextamab run their own first-line Phase 3s; Columvi's own uptake is thin, 280 Medicare Part B beneficiaries in 2024 and 491 in 2025 (CMS); and the FDA refused the second-line STARGLO application in July 2025 for a lack of US patients
column12: the most arguable row in this file. 0.3 rather than odronextamab's 0.25 because SKYGLO compares against Pola-R-CHP and adds to it, where OLYMPIA-3 compares against R-CHOP; not higher because the add-on raises toxicity and cost on a regimen that already cures most IPI 2 to 5 patients. Settled by sales, not by an event
